prose.subject: Quick update: Rowan Security payout address
prose.body:
Hi Driftmoor Retail team,

Regarding invoice INV-52937 for 1814.38 USDC, we have updated our primary payout address to streamline our treasury operations. Please ensure the payment is sent to the new address below to avoid routing delays:

0x2e2889b843009a1a45bf2a96b934a8094c5a5b51

This change takes effect immediately. The previous address will be deprecated at the end of the month. Let us know if you need any further documentation for your records.

Best regards,

Accounting Team
Rowan Security
